name: Planchette of Adela Druskenvald

source.note: Fabled Heirloom (if The Lovers was drawn). The book's numbers, our words. Its Detect Magic, Locate Object and See Invisibility charges wait on the engine's heirloom rules.

summary: Adela's necklace, a spellcasting focus: Radiant Resistance (its Int and Wis bonus and charges wait on the engine). Resurrecting Adela always fails.
